name: ModelVariant163_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant163_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a disc grows on a slot part, eight spinning tiles fly from it into a 4x2 grid near the other slot, the grid flashes and is pushed towards that slot, the tiles fly back and a glowing double ring opens behind a fading screen flash); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the disc and tiles, packs two texture images and starts the delay, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the closing flash and hold begin, 1 once when they do, 2 after the tiles have flown back and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-180 and 310 images build it from the same source with a 256-line flash. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
